page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n1.xlarge is an x86_64 virtual instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. Allocated under the KVM hypervisor, it provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The processor features 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 35 MB L3 cache, with hardware support for instruction set extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES.

The configuration provides 16.0 GB of memory, resulting in a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio (2.0 GB per core). It does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistence, and it contains no GPU accelerators. In benchmark evaluations, multi-threaded workloads perform moderately well, reflected by average tier scores in Geekbench multi-core (4900.0) and PassMark CPU (10044.03). However, single-core capabilities are constrained, with Geekbench single-core scoring in the lowest 10% (927.0) and stress-ng single-core in the bottom 25%.

Given the lower memory-to-vCPU ratio and modest per-core throughput, this instance is oriented toward compute workloads with moderate parallelism rather than memory-heavy or high-frequency processing. It is technically appropriate for distributed microservices, standard CI/CD compilation, and batch tasks that can effectively use multiple cores without requiring high memory allocations per thread.
